title: Folate–B12 coupling adds uncertain predictive value for homocysteine across two NHANES cycles
abstract: In exploratory transfer from NHANES 2003–2004 (4,159 adults) to 2005–2006 (3,976), a log-folate × log-B12 interaction reduced weighted log-homocysteine MSE by 0.0001352 (0.24%). The joint source/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval for added-minus-baseline MSE was -0.0005566 to +0.0003529; incremental predictive benefit was not established.
